spreadsheet.description: Configure authentication service to support OIDC/SAML for enterprise login, ensuring mandatory SSO for all users and enforcing MFA for Admin/PM roles as per compliance mandates.
Develop background worker to sync with Outlook/Google Calendar APIs, retrieve meeting participant lists, and trigger the processing pipeline upon meeting completion.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-003: AI Pipeline - Transcription & Speaker Diarization
spreadsheet.description: Integrate Whisper/Deepgram ASR model to process raw audio streams, outputting timestamped text segments mapped to unique Speaker IDs.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-004: Implement Action Item Extraction Engine
spreadsheet.description: Develop an NLP service utilizing NER and intent classification to parse meeting transcripts into structured JSON (Owner, Due Date, Task) for storage in the ActionItems table.

spreadsheet.summary: JIRA-005: Setup Vector Database for Semantic Search
spreadsheet.description: Deploy and configure Qdrant to store meeting embeddings (1536-dim). Implement search API to enable natural language querying across meeting history.
Create an API gateway middleware that validates user roles (ADMIN, EXEC, PM, EMPLOYEE) and filters meeting visibility based on participant/invitee status.
Implement pattern matching and sentiment analysis to identify 'High/Med/Low' risks within transcripts and surface them in the Executive dashboard.
Optimize the AuditLog write operations to ensure non-blocking logging for high-traffic AI query endpoints to prevent API timeout.
